acceptance_gate: A proves its claims with checks that rebuild every failing system and verify its circuits and free sets by brute force; every control is rejected.
objective: Serves open question 3 of docs/KNOT_INTUITION.md (composition) after KNOT-IMAGES-20261021-001, which proved that Latin circuits compose like cycles, left the Latin conjecture (no overlapping circuit) open, and showed that the 3-net law of the quaternion group Q8 has no polymorphism Mal'tsev modulo its top, so that either that law fails in large systems or Conjecture 7 of CYCLE-TOPS-20261021-001B-P001 is false. The owner approved deciding whether that 3-net composes like cycles: build the relation behind the certificate, test elimination and the Latin property on systems built from it, then attempt a proof through the Latin-circuits theorem. Scoping found that the relation is Thomsen's configuration (for groups: x2^-1 x1 and x3^-1 x1 commute), whose top image over Q8 is not affine; that it is a knot that allows x2 = x1 for every x3, so its fibres overlap; and that two copies sharing two variables fail elimination. The same doubling applies to every overlapping knot. A proves that no circuit of a law composing like cycles overlaps (the Latin conjecture), so composing like cycles is exactly having Latin circuits modulo the tops; that the 3-net of Q8 fails; and that the 3-net law of a Latin square composes like cycles exactly for isotopes of abelian p-groups.
status: Complete 2026-10-21. The 3-net law of Q8 does not compose like cycles: Thomsen's configuration (for groups, x2^-1 x1 and x3^-1 x1 commute) is a knot that allows x2 = x1, two copies sharing x1 and x2 violate elimination in a 16-variable system, and its top image omega(c1 + c2, c1 + c3) = 0 is the non-affine relation behind the 416-equation certificate. More generally no circuit of a law composing like cycles overlaps modulo the tops (the Latin conjecture holds), so a law composes like cycles exactly when its circuits are Latin hypercubes modulo proper pp-definable equivalences; a Latin square's 3-net law does so exactly when the square is isotopic to an abelian p-group, and every non-abelian group fails. Conjecture 7 of CYCLE-TOPS-20261021-001B-P001 (Mal'tsev on knot tops) survives, open. Next (owner's decision): Mal'tsev structure on the tops, starting from three-variable circuits as abelian p-group isotopes (3/3).
stop_rule: Stop after A. Stop earlier if a law composing like cycles in every checked system is found with an overlapping circuit modulo certified tops; that law would refute the doubling argument and become the subject.
title: Does the 3-net of Q8 compose like cycles?
